notes.title: Notice of TAPP update !
notes.content:
Hello.
Thank you to all who use TAPP.

Please see the following patch progress.


1. Added translation function for vertical strings in specific languages
   (Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese)

2. Added re-translation function using the shortcut keys in the designated area

3. Add New Language (Thai, Portuguese)

4. Tutorial corrections and additions

5. Expose notice window for updates

6. Improvement of program reliability


Also,
Our plans for future program development are:


[b][Future Plan][/b]

Tuesday, the second week of every month.

- Add Response Language 
- Improves stability 


Tuesday the fourth week of every month

- Add new features 
- Improves stability


We'll decide on the topic of the update as above, and we'll continue to patch it.


The following new features are currently planned for renewal:

1. Automatic translation function according to the set time of the specified area
2. Multi-monitor support
3. Multi-area translation function
4. UI / UX full reorganization

in addition,
Always listen to users ’opinions,
We will develop the required functions with priority and strive to be reflected in the update.

Thank you very much.
